company_id.description: stable SEC company identifier, equal to zero-padded CIK.

ticker.description: public ticker symbol from SEC company_tickers.json.

name.description: issuer name from SEC submissions JSON.

fiscal_year_end.description: fiscal year end from SEC submissions JSON.

filing_id.description: stable filing identifier, accession number without dashes.

accession_number.description: original SEC accession number with dashes.

form_type.description: SEC form type, restricted here to 10-K and 10-Q.

filing_date.description: EDGAR filing date in ISO format.

report_date.description: report period end date in ISO format when available.

fiscal_year.description: fiscal year inferred from companyfacts rows linked to the filing.

fiscal_period.description: fiscal period code such as Q1, Q2, Q3, or FY.

source_url.description: direct SEC archive URL for the raw filing HTML.

value.description: numeric fact value from SEC companyfacts.

unit_id.description: foreign key to unit.unit_id; units remain explicit.

period_start.description: start date for duration facts, empty for instant facts.

period_end.description: end date for the fact context.

fiscal_year.description: fiscal year supplied by SEC companyfacts when present.

fiscal_period.description: fiscal period supplied by SEC companyfacts when present.

revenue_usd.description: canonical revenue fact selected from SEC companyfacts for the filing.

assets_usd.description: canonical total assets fact for the filing.

liabilities_usd.description: canonical total liabilities fact for the filing.

net_income_usd.description: canonical net income or profit/loss fact for the filing.

operating_cash_flow_usd.description: canonical operating cash flow fact for the filing.

shares_outstanding.description: canonical shares outstanding fact for the filing.

market_cap_usd.description: reserved column; null because SEC companyfacts does not provide a reliable filing-level market cap series across issuers.
